regime_context: The detector shows a single, narrow, one-narrative regime: Banks (H + HK) is the lone clearly eligible theme (0.56 durability, score 1.19), everything except Conglomerates & Exchange is ineligible, and breadth is only 0.12 of themes. The rotating leader-challenger margin is thin (0.208) and absorption is mid (0.48), so leadership is concentrated but not deeply entrenched; the absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps=true), so the eligible/ineligible split is the one trustable leg. Cross-sectional rank is display-only focus context, not alpha.
emerging_watch: Watching whether challenger Energy (H-shares) breaches the eligibility/durability bar (currently ineligible, 0.36 durability vs 0.56 leader) — if Energy flips eligible=true while Banks holds lead, that confirms a second-leg rotation; if Energy stays ineligible for another two weeks, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the only durable, eligible, non-crowded leader in a one-narrative regime where the absolute-trend gate is validated. Its durability (0.56) is the highest of any theme and it carries the regime's leadership by score, so the trend-following, vol-aware posture points to staying with the leader rather than rotating away. Momentum rank is a focus lens, not a forecast, so this is a conditional stay-with-leader call, not a return prediction.
